name: GateStructure - Default (seed v1)
description: A gate: its address, WorldGuard region, spawn point, siege behaviour and doors. Each door is its own record, listed at the bottom of the page.

sections.description: The gate's name, description and menu icon.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Shown in game and used by /gate commands.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: One line for admins, e.g. what the gate guards.

fields.label: Icon
fields.description: Item shown for this gate in menus. Empty = the default icon.

sections.description: Where the gate stands. A gate has no house number.

fields.label: District
fields.description: The district the gate belongs to. The gate's region should lie inside the district's region.

fields.label: Town
fields.description: The town that district is part of.

fields.label: Street
fields.description: The street the gate is on.

sections.description: The WorldGuard region around the whole gate, and whether players may walk in and out of it.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: The WorldGuard region that encloses the gate and all its doors. Door points must lie inside it.

fields.label: World
fields.description: The Minecraft world the region is in. Region names are only unique within one world.

fields.label: Allow entry
fields.description: Players may walk into the gate's region. Off keeps everyone out except admins.

fields.label: Allow exit
fields.description: Players inside the gate's region may walk out of it.

sections.description: Where /gate tp, /warp and /navigate put players. Empty when not set: /gate tp then uses the first door. Edit opens the location.

fields.label: X
fields.description: East-west coordinate.

fields.label: Y
fields.description: Height.

fields.label: Z
fields.description: North-south coordinate.

fields.label: World
fields.description: The world the point is in.

sections.description: Whether players can /warp to the gate and where /navigate leads. Changed with Edit.

fields.label: Warp destination
fields.description: Listed in /warp. A warp also needs a spawn point and entry allowed.

fields.label: Warp price (gems)
fields.description: Gems charged for each warp here. 0 = free.

fields.label: Only after discovery
fields.description: Only players who have discovered this gate may warp here.

fields.label: /navigate leads to
fields.description: Spawn or Region: where /navigate <gate> takes players. Empty = the default for gates.

fields.label: Road access
fields.description: Applies or Ignored: whether the entry rule keeps routes off the roads in this region. Empty = the default for gates.

sections.description: How the gate behaves when a siege match uses it.

fields.label: Animate during a siege
fields.description: Doors open and close with their animation during a match. Off switches them instantly.

fields.label: Siege may take over
fields.description: A siege match may take control of this gate's doors. Off keeps the gate out of every siege.

fields.label: Locked by siege match
fields.description: Number of the siege match that has the gate locked down right now. Empty when none. Set by the server.

fields.label: Siege objective
fields.description: On while a running match uses this gate as an objective. Set and cleared by the siege plugin.

sections.description: Values forced on every door of this gate at once. "-" means no override: each door uses its own setting. Overrides are not changed with Edit.

fields.label: Active
fields.description: Forces all doors active (loaded and usable) or inactive.

fields.label: Open state
fields.description: Forces all doors open or closed.

fields.label: Invincible
fields.description: Forces whether the doors can be damaged.

fields.label: Destroyed
fields.description: Forces all doors destroyed or intact.

fields.label: Respawns
fields.description: Forces whether destroyed doors rebuild themselves.

fields.label: Pass-through
fields.description: Forces whether players may be let through closed doors.

fields.label: Pass-through time (seconds)
fields.description: Forces how long a door stays open for a pass-through.

fields.label: Show health
fields.description: Forces the health line in the doors' floating text.

sections.description: Every door of the gate with its type, state and health. Edit opens the door's own form; add doors by editing the gate.

fields.label: Door
fields.description: Unique within the gate; /gatedoor commands use it.

fields.label: Type
fields.description: Sliding, trap, drawbridge or double doors.

fields.label: State
fields.description: Whether the door is open or closed right now.

fields.label: Health
fields.description: Current health / maximum health.

fields.label: Active
fields.description: Loaded and usable in game.

fields.label: Destroyed
fields.description: Broken down; rebuilds after its respawn time if it respawns.

notes: Icon: the read DTO calls the material "iconMaterialRef"; the model navigation is "IconMaterial", which the DTO does not carry, hence metadataCheck "warn".
Town: GateStructureDistrictDto carries "townName"; the District model has a Town navigation instead.
